name: RAP-7000 Digital Inverter
description:
Air Purifier
Product Description
Breathe cleaner, healthier air every day with the Royal Air Purifier 7000 Digital Inverter. Designed and manufactured in Pakistan by Pakistan's first Made in Pakistan Air Purifier Brand, this advanced purifier protects your family from dust, smoke, odors, pollen, bacteria and viruses.
With a real-time AQI display, you don’t just hope the air is clean — you can see it. Whether in your bedroom, living room, or office, enjoy fresh air with whisper-quiet operation and ultra-low energy use.

Frequently Asked Questions
When do I need to change the filters?
On average every 6–12 months, depending on air quality and usage.
Replacement filters are available here:
👉 Royal Air Purifier Filters
How can I check the Air Quality Index (AQI) in my area?
You can check live air quality in your area by visiting waqi.info. Simply enter your city name to see real-time AQI data, which shows if the air is safe, moderate, or hazardous. Our purifier also provides a built-in digital AQI display so you can track indoor air quality instantly.
Why is clean air so important for health?
Breathing polluted air with high levels of PM2.5 can increase the risk of heart disease, asthma, allergies, and lung problems. Children and elderly people are especially vulnerable. Using an air purifier reduces these risks, improves sleep quality, boosts immunity, and helps manage conditions like asthma and seasonal allergies.
Is it energy-efficient?
Yes. The Royal Air Purifier is powered by an Inverter BLDC motor, consuming just 1.5W at minimum and only 30W at maximum.
Will it disturb my sleep?
No. In Night Mode the purifier runs at just 35 dB, quieter than a whisper, so you can sleep peacefully while breathing clean air.

name: Sonex Electric Pedestal Heater with Ceramic Plate, 2 Heat Settings and 180° Oscillation, White and Copper-Tone Finish
description:
Sonex Electric Pedestal Heater with Ceramic Plate, 2 Heat Settings and 180° Oscillation, White and Copper-Tone Finish
Electric Heater Highlights
·         Low and high heat settings. Choose between two heat levels to suit your comfort. Front-mounted rotary controls make everyday adjustments straightforward.
·         180° wide-angle oscillation. Side-to-side movement changes the direction of warmth across a wider angle, giving you more flexibility than a fixed-facing heater.
·         Ceramic heating plate. A ceramic heating plate sits within the circular reflector-style heater head, with a metal front grille completing the design.
·         Freestanding pedestal design. The upright column keeps the heater head raised above its broad, stepped floor base. Place the unit on a suitable level surface with the clearance required in its instructions.
·         White and copper-tone finish. Heat-resistant plastic housing, a silver-coloured grille and copper-tone accents give this standing room heater a distinctive look for home interiors.
Electric Pedestal Heater Description
Make cooler days more comfortable with the Sonex Electric Pedestal Heater, a freestanding room heater with a ceramic heating plate and a distinctive white and copper-tone finish. Its circular reflector-style head and upright pedestal design bring a familiar, practical heating option to a living room, study or home office.
Choose low or high heat to match your comfort, using the rotary controls on the front of the pedestal. The two heat settings keep the choice simple, while 180° wide-angle oscillation moves the heater head from side to side. This changes the direction of warmth across a wider angle without requiring you to keep repositioning the entire appliance.
The circular metal front grille, heat-resistant plastic housing and broad stepped base form a coordinated design. Copper-tone details around the neck, control panel and lower collar contrast with the white body and silver reflector, making the heater easy to coordinate with both modern and traditional rooms.
For shoppers comparing electric room heaters in Pakistan, this Sonex pedestal heater combines ceramic heating, adjustable heat settings and oscillation in one floor-standing appliance. It is a practical option for adding local warmth while reading, relaxing or working indoors. The warmth you experience will depend on placement, room conditions and the heat setting you select. Follow the supplied operating instructions and let the heater cool before moving or cleaning it.

Certainly! Below is a step-by-step connecting procedure to pair a Tamoor Fan 30 Watt with the Smart Life or Tuya app:
Install Smart Life or Tuya App:
– Download and install the Smart Life or Tuya app from your device’s app store.
– Open the app and sign up using your email address.
Access Device Addition:
– Once logged in, navigate to the main screen of the app.
– Look for the “+” (plus) icon usually located in the top right corner of the screen.
Add Device:
– Click on the “+” icon to access a drop-down menu.
Select Device Addition:
– From the drop-down menu, choose the option to “Add Device.”
Search for Device:
– The app will initiate a search for available devices, and a radar-like animation will appear.
Identify Your Device:
– Your Tamoor Fan 30 Watt will appear on the screen with a random alphanumeric identifier (e.g., FG-6890-2).
Connect to the Device:
– Tap on your device (Tamoor Fan) from the list, and press the “Connect” button.
Establish Connection:
– Follow any on-screen instructions to complete the pairing process. This may involve connecting to the fan’s Wi-Fi network or entering a pairing code.
Confirmation:
– Once successfully connected, you will receive a confirmation message indicating that your Tamoor Fan 30 Watt is now paired with the Smart Life or Tuya app.
Control Your Fan:
– Return to the main screen of the app, and you will now be able to control your Tamoor Fan 30 Watt directly from your device. Adjust settings such as speed, oscillation, and other features as needed.

name: Glamour Plus Model
description:
Remote Paring Guide for Eco Smart 30 Watt Fans:
Turn on fan
As soon as you turn on the fan press pair button
Hold the button for 10-15 sec
You will hear the beep sound
Your fan has been paired with your remote.
Connection Procedure:
Certainly! Below is a step-by-step connecting procedure to pair a Tamoor Fan 30 Watt with the Smart Life or Tuya app:
Install Smart Life or Tuya App:
– Download and install the Smart Life or Tuya app from your device’s app store.
– Open the app and sign up using your email address.
Access Device Addition:
– Once logged in, navigate to the main screen of the app.
– Look for the “+” (plus) icon usually located in the top right corner of the screen.
Add Device:
– Click on the “+” icon to access a drop-down menu.
Select Device Addition:
– From the drop-down menu, choose the option to “Add Device.”
Search for Device:
– The app will initiate a search for available devices, and a radar-like animation will appear.
Identify Your Device:
– Your Tamoor Fan 30 Watt will appear on the screen with a random alphanumeric identifier (e.g., FG-6890-2).
Connect to the Device:
– Tap on your device (Tamoor Fan) from the list, and press the “Connect” button.
Establish Connection:
– Follow any on-screen instructions to complete the pairing process. This may involve connecting to the fan’s Wi-Fi network or entering a pairing code.
Confirmation:
– Once successfully connected, you will receive a confirmation message indicating that your Tamoor Fan 30 Watt is now paired with the Smart Life or Tuya app.
Control Your Fan:
– Return to the main screen of the app, and you will now be able to control your Tamoor Fan 30 Watt directly from your device. Adjust settings such as speed, oscillation, and other features as needed.

name: Magnum Plus Model
description:
Remote Paring Guide for Eco Smart30 Watt Fans:
Step 1: Power Down the Fan
Turn OFF the fan via the wall switch.
Wait for the fan blades to come to a complete stop before proceeding.
Step 2: Prepare for Pairing Mode
Restore power to the fan by switching it ON using the wall switch.
The fan’s control module is now in standby mode, ready for pairing.
Step 3: Initiate Pairing
On the remote control, locate the Pair or Function (Fn) button.
Press and hold the Pair/Fn button for 5–10 seconds.
Step 4: Confirmation of Pairing
Listen for a beep sound from the fan’s receiver unit, indicating successful synchronization.
If the beep does not occur, repeat steps 1–3 and ensure the remote has functional batteries.
Step 5: Test Remote Functionality
Use the remote control to operate the fan (speed adjustment, oscillation, light, etc.).
If the fan responds correctly, pairing is complete.
If unresponsive, reset the fan’s power and retry the pairing procedure.

description:
Voldam Slim, Unique and Stylish Exhaust Fan in Elegant Grey
The primary purpose for having an exhaust fan is to remove the odor, moisture and unpleasant out of the bathroom and improve indoor air quality. Voldam ventilation fans help to control and eliminate bathroom odors.
Without a bathroom ventilating fan, bathrooms are susceptible to excessive moisture buildup that increases the chances of damaging bathroom walls, floors, and ceilings, as well as bathroom fixtures. Warm, humid air, caused by running hot water for baths and showers, is a perfect environment for mold, mildew and microorganism growth. High moisture in rooms can also break down interior room materials such as wallboard, wall paint, and trim, not to mention the entry door.
Additionally, they add to the safety of the home and its residents by reducing fumes from cleaning agents that could potentially cause health-related issues. For good ventilation, an exhaust fan should run for a minimum of 15 minutes after every bathroom visit.

Warm, humid air, caused by running hot water for baths and showers, is a perfect environment for mold, mildew and microorganism growth. High moisture in rooms can also break down interior room materials such as wallboard, wall paint, and trim, not to mention the entry door.
Additionally, they add to the safety of the home and its residents by reducing fumes from cleaning agents that could potentially cause health-related issues. For good ventilation, an exhaust fan should run for a minimum of 15 minutes after every bathroom visit.
